definitions.explanation: A chemical substance used to destroy or inhibit harmful microorganisms on surfaces, instruments, or skin.

examples.japanese: {傷口|きずぐち}に{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}を{塗|ぬ}った。
examples.english: I applied antiseptic to the wound.

examples.japanese: {入口|いりぐち}に{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}が{置|お}いてある。
examples.english: There is disinfectant placed at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}では{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}を{使|つか}って{器具|きぐ}を{清潔|せいけつ}に{保|たも}っている。
examples.english: Hospitals use disinfectant to keep instruments clean.

notes:
A compound of {消毒|しょうどく} (disinfection, sterilization) + {剤|ざい} (agent, preparation). Became an everyday term during the COVID-19 pandemic, when hand sanitizers and surface disinfectants became ubiquitous in public spaces across Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消毒剤|しょうどくざい}で{拭|ふ}く: to wipe with disinfectant
- {消毒剤|しょうどくざい}を{噴霧|ふんむ}する: to spray disinfectant
- アルコール{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}: alcohol-based disinfectant
- {手指|しゅし}{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}: hand sanitizer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {殺菌剤|さっきんざい}: germicide, bactericide — focuses on killing bacteria, while {消毒剤|しょうどくざい} focuses on making something safe from infection
- {除菌|じょきん}スプレー: antibacterial spray — a consumer product term
- {消毒液|しょうどくえき}: disinfectant solution — specifically a liquid form
